messages:
Priya: Quick coverage ask — we have a backend infra candidate on Wed 15:00 PT (3pm PT). Need 2 panelists + scribe. Can anyone swap into the slot? Calendar: https://calendar.company.com/event/abc123 :calendar:
Samir: I can cover the panel but I’ll need to drop at ~15:40 for an all-hands. Can scribe for first 40m if that helps. :thumbsup:
Aisha: I can take the full slot if Samir needs to cut. Quick question: what are we weighting in the rubric this round? architecture vs execution?
Priya: Thanks both. Current rubric is 60/40 architecture/execution, with a small (10%) collaboration/communication note that we use during normalization. Please call out specific signals/examples in the notes.
Priya: Also pasted a tiny debrief checklist you can copy into the form:
Priya: ```debrief-checklist
- 3 strengths
- 2 concerns/risks
- Hire / No-hire / Hold recommendation
- Confidence (1-5)
- Note if follow-up interview needed (yes/no)
```
Elena: Quick clarifying Q — do we want a separate subscore for "scalability" under architecture? candidate's takehome focuses on scaling patterns.
Priya: Yes — add a "scalability" bullet under architecture and mark specific reasoning (tradeoffs, ops cost, fallback plans). If you reference the takehome, paste the snippet/link into the debrief.
Raj: Heads up — if you need extra coverage ping #eng-ml for an extra panelist. Also tagging ops-bot to schedule reminder. If someone picks scribe, please edit the calendar invite and set "Scribe: <your name>" in the description.
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled for Wed 14:30 PT for panel thread 1765557777. Use `/debrief-fill` to open the form after the interview.
Samir: I left a small comment on the candidate's repo PR #34 — nothing blocking but would be good for the panel to glance at the approach. TL;DR: could split the caching layer differently.
Aisha: Saw the PR — looks minor. I'll skim before the panel and surface any concerns during the execution questions.
Priya: Awesome. Final ask: if you take scribe, drop your name in the invite and paste a 1-sentence TL;DR in the debrief form (we normalize on that). I’ll collect notes after and open the normalization thread. Thanks! :sparkles:
